Submit a Template

Your HTML template enters a review queue. Once approved it goes live in the CoCo ecosystem under your name.

✦ Your template appears in the Flourish workspace and in CoCo packs — credited to you.
✦ Approved templates earn 70% of every sale they're included in once revenue share is live.
✦ Review takes 2–5 business days. You'll get an email when it's approved or if changes are needed.
Step 1 — Choose how to submit
GitHub Pages, Netlify, Squarespace, or any public URL. Figma prototype links work too.
